_about: More of Windows' own programs: built-in apps, admin tools, command-line helpers and background parts.

consent.exe.title: Admin permission prompt
consent.exe.what: The "Do you want to allow this app to make changes?" prompt.
consent.exe.note: The prompt closes as if you said No.

logonui.exe.title: Sign-in screen
logonui.exe.what: Shows the screen where you type your password or PIN.
logonui.exe.note: The sign-in screen may stop working.

userinit.exe.title: Sign-in setup
userinit.exe.what: Sets up your desktop right after you sign in.
userinit.exe.note: It finishes by itself in seconds.

searchprotocolhost.exe.title: File search reader
searchprotocolhost.exe.what: Reads inside your files so Windows Search can find words in them.

searchfilterhost.exe.title: File search reader
searchfilterhost.exe.what: Reads inside your files so Windows Search can find words in them.

searchapp.exe.title: Windows Search
searchapp.exe.what: The search box in the taskbar (Windows 10).
searchapp.exe.note: Windows reopens it next time you search.

comppkgsrv.exe.title: Store app helper
comppkgsrv.exe.what: Helps Store apps use shared parts of Windows.

systemsettingsbroker.exe.title: Settings helper
systemsettingsbroker.exe.what: Lets the Settings app change protected options.

systemsettingsadminflows.exe.title: Settings admin helper
systemsettingsadminflows.exe.what: Makes admin-only changes for the Settings app.
systemsettingsadminflows.exe.note: The change you were making may not apply.

securityhealthhost.exe.title: Windows Security helper
securityhealthhost.exe.what: Helps the Windows Security window do its checks.

mpcmdrun.exe.title: Defender scan tool
mpcmdrun.exe.what: Runs Microsoft Defender scans and virus-definition updates.
mpcmdrun.exe.note: A scan or update in progress stops.

mpcopyaccelerator.exe.title: Defender copy helper
mpcopyaccelerator.exe.what: Speeds up virus checks when you copy files.

dismhost.exe.title: Windows repair helper
dismhost.exe.what: Installs or repairs parts of Windows.
dismhost.exe.note: A repair or install in progress fails.

sppsvc.exe.title: Windows activation
sppsvc.exe.what: Confirms your copies of Windows and Office are genuine.

wuauclt.exe.title: Windows Update
wuauclt.exe.what: Looks for Windows updates and installs them.
wuauclt.exe.note: Updates pause and try again later.

musnotification.exe.title: Windows Update messages
musnotification.exe.what: Shows Windows Update messages like "Restart to finish updating".

musnotificationux.exe.title: Windows Update messages
musnotificationux.exe.what: Shows Windows Update messages like "Restart to finish updating".

musnotifyicon.exe.title: Windows Update icon
musnotifyicon.exe.what: The update icon in the taskbar corner.

sihclient.exe.title: Windows repair updater
sihclient.exe.what: Downloads fixes that repair Windows Update when it's broken.

upfc.exe.title: Update readiness check
upfc.exe.what: Checks this PC is ready for Windows updates.

devicecensus.exe.title: Device info collector
devicecensus.exe.what: Collects basic details about this PC's hardware for Microsoft.

mrt.exe.title: Malware removal tool
mrt.exe.what: Microsoft's monthly scan for common malware.
mrt.exe.note: The scan stops; it runs again next month.

windowspackagemanagerserver.exe.title: winget helper
windowspackagemanagerserver.exe.what: Background helper for winget, Windows' app installer.
windowspackagemanagerserver.exe.note: An install in progress may fail.

settingsynchost.exe.title: Settings sync
settingsynchost.exe.what: Syncs your Windows settings with your Microsoft account.
settingsynchost.exe.note: Settings stop syncing until next sign-in.

locationnotificationwindows.exe.title: Location in use alert
locationnotificationwindows.exe.what: Shows the alert when an app uses your location.

pickerhost.exe.title: File picker
pickerhost.exe.what: The Open and Save file windows apps show you.

credentialuibroker.exe.title: Password prompt
credentialuibroker.exe.what: Pops up Windows' password or PIN box when an app needs you to confirm it's you.

credentialenrollmentmanager.exe.title: Windows Hello setup
credentialenrollmentmanager.exe.what: Sets up Windows Hello PIN, face or fingerprint.

bthudtask.exe.title: Bluetooth device setup
bthudtask.exe.what: Finishes setting up a Bluetooth device.

wmiadap.exe.title: System info counters
wmiadap.exe.what: Updates the performance counters Windows tools read.

wmiapsrv.exe.title: System info counters
wmiapsrv.exe.what: Hands performance numbers (like CPU use) to tools that ask for them.

mobsync.exe.title: Sync Center
mobsync.exe.what: Syncs offline copies of network files.

printisolationhost.exe.title: Printer driver runner
printisolationhost.exe.what: Runs printer drivers apart from Windows, so a bad driver can't crash it.
printisolationhost.exe.note: Printing may fail until it restarts.

splwow64.exe.title: Printing helper
splwow64.exe.note: Printing from older apps may fail.

vssvc.exe.title: Restore points
vssvc.exe.what: Takes file snapshots for restore points and backups.
vssvc.exe.note: A backup in progress may fail.

ngentask.exe.title: .NET app optimiser
ngentask.exe.what: Gets .NET apps ready while your PC is idle, so they open faster.

mscorsvw.exe.title: .NET app optimiser
mscorsvw.exe.what: Gets .NET apps ready while your PC is idle, so they open faster.

ngen.exe.title: .NET app optimiser
ngen.exe.what: Prepares .NET apps so they start faster.

w3wp.exe.title: Local website (IIS)
w3wp.exe.what: Runs a website on this PC's built-in web server.

lpremove.exe.title: Language pack cleanup
lpremove.exe.what: Removes language packs you don't use.

gamebarftserver.exe.title: Game Bar helper
gamebarftserver.exe.what: Background helper for Xbox Game Bar.
gamebarftserver.exe.note: Game Bar restarts it when needed.

gamebarpresencewriter.exe.title: Game activity reporter
gamebarpresencewriter.exe.what: Tells Xbox which game you're playing, for your friends list.

xboxappservices.exe.title: Xbox app helper
xboxappservices.exe.what: Does behind-the-scenes jobs for the Xbox app.

yourphone.exe.title: Phone Link (old)
yourphone.exe.what: The older Phone Link: your phone's texts, calls and photos on the PC.

widgetboard.exe.title: Widgets board
widgetboard.exe.what: The news and weather widgets panel.
widgetboard.exe.note: Widgets reopen when you open the board.

video.ui.exe.title: Movies & TV
video.ui.exe.what: Plays your video files; the older Windows video app.

magnify.exe.title: Magnifier
magnify.exe.what: Zooms in on part of the screen.

osk.exe.title: On-screen keyboard
osk.exe.what: A keyboard you click with the mouse.

tabtip.exe.title: Touch keyboard (old)
tabtip.exe.what: Older touch keyboard and handwriting panel.

fontview.exe.title: Font viewer
fontview.exe.what: Shows a preview of a font.

winver.exe.title: About Windows
winver.exe.what: Shows which Windows version you have.

mmc.exe.title: Management console
mmc.exe.what: Windows admin tools like Device Manager, Disk Management or the Services window.

regedit.exe.title: Registry Editor
regedit.exe.note: Changes are saved as you make them.

perfmon.exe.title: Performance Monitor
perfmon.exe.what: Windows tool that charts how hard your PC is working.

resmon.exe.title: Resource Monitor
resmon.exe.what: Windows tool showing CPU, memory, disk and network use per app.

msinfo32.exe.title: System Information
msinfo32.exe.what: Shows details about your PC's hardware and Windows.

msconfig.exe.title: System Configuration
msconfig.exe.what: Windows tool for start-up and boot options.

cleanmgr.exe.title: Disk Cleanup
cleanmgr.exe.what: Deletes temporary files to free up space.

diskpart.exe.title: DiskPart
diskpart.exe.note: A drive change in progress may be left unfinished.

chkdsk.exe.title: Check Disk
chkdsk.exe.what: Checks a drive for errors and fixes them.
chkdsk.exe.note: A check or repair stops halfway.

sfc.exe.title: System File Checker
sfc.exe.what: Checks Windows' own files and repairs damaged ones.

wscript.exe.title: Windows script runner
wscript.exe.what: Runs old-style Windows scripts (.vbs, .js). Check what started it.

cscript.exe.title: Windows script runner (text)
cscript.exe.what: Runs old-style Windows scripts (.vbs, .js) in a text window. Check what started it.

mshta.exe.title: HTML app runner
mshta.exe.what: Runs .hta files: small apps built from web pages. Rare today; check what started it.

certutil.exe.title: Certificate tool
certutil.exe.what: Command-line tool for certificates. It can also download files.

schtasks.exe.title: Scheduled task command
schtasks.exe.what: Creates or changes scheduled tasks from the command line.

reg.exe.title: Registry command
reg.exe.what: Reads or changes Windows settings from the command line.

netsh.exe.title: Network settings command
netsh.exe.what: Reads or changes network settings from the command line.

tasklist.exe.title: Process list command
tasklist.exe.what: A typed command that prints the list of open programs.

taskkill.exe.title: End-program command
taskkill.exe.what: Ends a program from the command line.

where.exe.title: Find-program command
where.exe.what: Finds where a program is installed.

whoami.exe.title: Who-am-I command
whoami.exe.what: Shows which user account is signed in.

ping.exe.title: Ping
ping.exe.what: Checks whether another computer or website answers.

tracert.exe.title: Trace route
tracert.exe.what: Shows the path your traffic takes to a website.

robocopy.exe.title: Robocopy
robocopy.exe.note: A copy in progress stops halfway.

xcopy.exe.title: XCopy
xcopy.exe.what: Copies files from the command line.
xcopy.exe.note: A copy in progress stops halfway.

timeout.exe.title: Wait command
timeout.exe.what: Waits a few seconds inside a script.

wmic.exe.title: System info command (old)
wmic.exe.what: Older command-line tool that asks Windows for details.

sc.exe.title: Service command
sc.exe.what: Starts, stops or changes Windows services from the command line.

net.exe.title: Network and accounts command
net.exe.what: Manages network shares, user accounts and services.

net1.exe.title: Network and accounts command
net1.exe.what: Manages network shares, user accounts and services.

icacls.exe.title: File permissions command
icacls.exe.what: Reads or changes who can open files and folders.
icacls.exe.note: Permission changes may be left half done.

takeown.exe.title: Take ownership command
takeown.exe.what: Makes you the owner of files or folders.
takeown.exe.note: Ownership changes may be left half done.

regsvr32.exe.title: Add-on registrar
regsvr32.exe.what: Registers a program add-on with Windows. Check what started it.

cmstp.exe.title: VPN profile installer
cmstp.exe.what: Installs network connection profiles. Rarely used; check what started it.

installutil.exe.title: .NET installer tool
installutil.exe.what: Installs parts of .NET programs. Check what started it.

forfiles.exe.title: Run-on-files command
forfiles.exe.what: Runs a command on many files at once.
